name: Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer
description: The wreckage of a Venator-class Star Destroyer was present in the Zavian Abyss the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron came across the wreckage of a Venator-class, while escorting three GR-75 medium transports, before coming into contact with the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Overseer. This was part of a New Republic ambush in the Zavian Abyss, where they revealed their prototype Starhawk.
